notes.title: CrossAbout, new word game in the IndieCade Steam Event!
notes.content:
Like word games and crossword puzzles? 
CrossAbout is new from Cinq-Mars Media!

IndieCade Steam Event going on now!

Try the demo and master the tutorial. When you buy the game, start with 300 stars for hints, puzzle packs, and bonus content.

Purchases support the mission of our non-profit to develop educational games which are provided free to teachers and students.
